name: @pipeworx/mcp-luma

tools.name: luma_places
tools.description: List Luma's curated discover cities (lu.ma/discover) — the place_id, coordinates and live event_count for each. Use this to find a place_id for luma_events, or just pass a city name to luma_events directly.

query.description: Optional substring filter on city name, e.g. "san" matches San Francisco, San Diego.

tools.name: luma_events
tools.description: List public upcoming events from a Luma discover city feed. Pass a city name (resolved for you) or a place_id from luma_places. Optional keyword filters event name/venue/calendar client-side. Never returns guest lists or attendee data.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "San Francisco" or "sf". Resolved to a Luma place_id.

place_id.description: A Luma discover place_id (e.g. "discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka") from luma_places. Use instead of city.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter by event name, venue or organizer (matched client-side; paginates up to 200 events to find matches).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor (ignored when query is set).

tools.name: luma_event
tools.description: Get full public detail for one Luma event — description, timing, venue, hosts, categories, ticket types and FAQs. Never returns guest lists or attendee data.

tools.name: luma_calendar_events
tools.description: List public upcoming events on a Luma organizer calendar page (e.g. a company's or community's event series). Never returns guest lists or attendee data.

calendar_id.description: A Luma calendar api_id, e.g. "cal-lYa2810srHvkQRC" (found on any of that calendar's events via luma_event or luma_events).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-luma forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the luma pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
